name: COMAddIn
description: Represents a COM add-in in the Microsoft Office host application. The COMAddIn object is a member of the COMAddIns collection.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Gets an Application object that represents the container application for the COMAddIn object (you can use this property with an Automation object to return that object's container application). Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Gets a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the COMAddIn object was created. Read-only.

properties.name: Description
properties.description: Gets or sets a descriptive String value for the specified COMAddin object. Read/write.

properties.name: ProgId
properties.description: Gets the programmatic identifier (ProgID) for the specified COMAddIn object. Read-only.

properties.name: Guid
properties.description: Gets the class identifier (CLSID) for the specified COMAddIn object. Read-only.

properties.name: Connect
properties.description: Gets or sets the state of the connection for the specified COMAddIn object. Read/write.

properties.name: Object
properties.description: Gets or sets an object reference. Read/write.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Gets the Parent object for the COMAddIn object. Read-only.
